title: Interstate / Highway land?
content: I have had a dream that I have not had in a while where the interstates or highways go underground and they exist as some sort of island system. Sometimes the interstate's go very high and then very steeply downward and it looks very dangerous. It ends up underground where a bunch of people are congregating like a train station. I used to work with a guy that swore he had the same recurring dream and we kind of freaked out about it for a little while. Anybody else have that one?
